# Wasim M Ansari Portfolio

Official portfolio: https://waseemmansari.github.io/

## Profile

Wasim M Ansari is an AI/ML Engineer and GenAI Solution Architect based in Dehradun, India. He builds production-focused AI systems including RAG chatbots, LangGraph agents, MCP servers/tools, knowledge graphs, document AI systems, time-series and inventory forecasting APIs, and cloud-deployed ML services.

Primary contact: wsmaisys@gmail.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/wsmaisys
GitHub: https://github.com/wsmaisys
Kaggle: https://www.kaggle.com/wasimansari786

## Core Expertise

- Generative AI and LLM applications
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- LangGraph and multi-agent workflows
- MCP servers and tool integrations
- FastAPI production services
- Knowledge graphs with Neo4j and Cypher
- Human-in-the-loop AI workflows
- Time-series and inventory forecasting
- ERP-integrated ML APIs
- Document AI and PDF/data extraction
- Cloud deployment with Docker, Google Cloud Run, Azure, and Render
- Python ML stack: Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow

## Featured Private Client Work

### HyreFast Intelligence Layer

Public platform: https://www.hyrefast.ai/

Private/confidential POC built for TechPranee. The portfolio describes the architecture and engineering contribution, but no source code or deployment link is public.

Summary: Neo4j-backed intelligence layer for HyreFast's interview-first hiring platform. It includes skill taxonomy ingestion, candidate skill normalization, workspace-scoped recruiter search, FastAPI review APIs, LangGraph/MCP-style tools, and human-in-the-loop review workflows for ambiguous candidate-skill matches.

### Zovia Inventory Forecasting Module

Public platform: https://www.zovia.ai/

Private/confidential module built for TechPranee. The portfolio links to the public Zovia platform but does not expose private source code or deployment details.

Summary: ERP-integrated inventory forecasting API for Zovia's manufacturing decision platform. It predicts weekly/monthly warehouse stock IN/OUT movement using TSB intermittent-demand forecasting, Monte Carlo simulation, FastAPI, Celery, Redis, MongoDB, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, and Docker.

## Featured Public Projects

- MediFlow: post-discharge medical AI assistant using LangGraph, RAG, FastAPI, FAISS, Mistral AI, Docker, and Google Cloud Run.
- Nephrology RAG MCP Tool: production MCP server with HTTP/SSE transport, authenticated medical knowledge access, FAISS, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud deployment options.
- PDF Excel Extractor: AI document structuring system for dynamic schema detection, batch PDF extraction, Excel export, and quality metrics.
- DocuDroid: RAG-based document analysis bot for surfacing code examples and documentation answers.
- Jurisol: Indian legal assistant using RAG, ChromaDB, FastAPI/Streamlit, and government legal database search.
- AI Assignment Solver: autonomous coding/data-analysis agent built for an IIT Madras competition.
